analysis: Both units are base-side excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 1238-2013). The PR changes to this file fall in other ranges (head ~4592-4608, 4805+, 6725+, etc.), mainly cluster served-speed record documentation (ClusterServedScope, tensorAssistant, ClusterServedSpeedRecords) and a tp-check --layer-stride option. The supplied patch excerpt is truncated, so the full diff is not visible. The base text I examined is documentation only, and no code or control changes appear in it. The surrounding text describes the SSD prefix cache (T-041), encrypted coordinator chunk delivery (ChunkBatcher, SendHandle), GLM5Next admission, media handling, and calibration. Nothing in the visible patch weakens those controls, and the visible patch concerns benchmarking records and the planner's selection of served speed records, which is not a security boundary. A documentation change cannot create a regression in itself. Open questions for integration: (1) whether the cluster served-speed records, which are self-reported by peer Macs and now split by serving scope, feed any coordinator-visible capacity or routing claims. That would touch the TB-002 provider-reported-metrics assumptions and the TB-011 non-certified capacity language (T-055). (2) The truncated patch tail (the tp-check --layer-stride change) was not visible. Neither point is evidenced as a regression. I am flagging needs_deeper_review only because the patch is truncated.
